title: 109 ## Disposal of Juveniles 5.8. A total of 1,50,212 juveniles were sent to the Courts during 1983. Cases in respect of 46.0 per cent of the total number of juveniles sent to courts remained pending for disposal at the end of the year. As compared to 1982, the pendency of disposal of juveniles registered a decline of 4.4 per cent during 1983 as the pendency of cases decreased from 72,279 in 1982 to 69,110 in 1983. During the year 1983, 27.0 per cent of the juveniles whose cases were sent to the Courts for disposal were either acquitted or otherwise disposed of in comparison to 18.8 per cent in 1982. The relevant statistics are set forth in Table-44. Of the 1,50,212 Juveniles sent to court during 1983, 8.6 per cent were restored to guardians, 1.8 per cent were placed on probation, 0.3 per cent were sent to Reformatories and Borstals, 1.1 per cent were sent to schools and institutions, 1.1 per cent were sent to adult institutions, 14.1 per cent were imprisoned, 27.0 per cent were acquitted or otherwise disposed of and cases in respect of 46.0 per cent of them were pending.
